AshenHeights_Text_Npc0.en: The ground is warm even in winter.
AshenHeights_Text_Npc0.fr: Le sol est chaud, même en hiver.

AshenHeights_Text_Npc1.en: TORKOAL carries coal on its back.\nReal coal!
AshenHeights_Text_Npc1.fr: CHARTOR porte du charbon sur le\ndos. Du vrai de vrai !

AshenHeights_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: I keep getting burned. Two BURN\nHEALs, a CHARCOAL for you.
AshenHeights_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: J'arrête pas de me brûler ! Deux\nANTI-BRÛLE et je te donne un\lCHARBON.

AshenHeights_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
AshenHeights_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

AshenHeights_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

AshenHeights_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

AshenHeights_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
AshenHeights_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Y a un truc qui brille ici, mais\nton SAC est plein.
